description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the Zeros class in the TensorFlow Java API, testing creation of zero tensors of various data types and validation of their contents.

classes.name: ZerosTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for the Zeros tensor creation utility in TensorFlow Java API, verifying correct tensor initialization for various data types.

methods.name: createIntZeros
methods.description: Tests creation of integer zero tensors and verifies all elements are zero.

methods.name: createFloatZeros
methods.description: Tests creation of float zero tensors and verifies all elements are zero within EPSILON tolerance.

methods.name: createDoubleZeros
methods.description: Tests creation of double zero tensors and verifies all elements are zero within EPSILON tolerance.

methods.name: createLongZeros
methods.description: Tests creation of long zero tensors and verifies all elements are zero.

methods.name: createBooleanZeros
methods.description: Tests creation of boolean zero tensors and verifies all elements are false.

methods.name: createUInt8Zeros
methods.description: Tests creation of UInt8 zero tensors and verifies all elements are zero.

methods.name: cannotCreateStringZeros
methods.description: Ensures that creating zero tensors of String type throws an IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: operationsComposingZerosAreCorrectlyNamed
methods.description: Verifies that the naming of operations composed within a named scope is correct.
